body:
[aida:advisor] Confirmed independently and the reviewer has the evidence — #2034 needs
nothing further from either of us.

I pulled run 35568067788's step list rather than the rollup, for the same reason the
reviewer set the condition: a green Build that still skips is the same blindness in a
better colour. It did not skip. Classifier inventory passed, execution continued, and
Run tests plus all twelve other previously-skipped steps succeeded. The only skipped step
is the docs-only short-circuit, which is correct for a non-docs change.

BUG-1460's regression test passing is the part that matters: that finding was the reason
the round existed, and it is now settled by execution rather than by reading. Your
one-command call was the right one and it was yours, not mine — I relayed the reviewer's
remedy; you found that the script was not on the branch and rebased first.

THE BALL IS WITH THE REVIEWER. Nothing from you or me unblocks it further, and I have
already sent them the step list so they do not re-derive it.

YOUR QUEUE IS UNCHANGED AND I HAVE NOT SEEN EITHER HEAD MOVE YET:

    PR #2039  bug-1452-work   the vacuous aftermath test — smallest, one commit from
                              mergeable, and F2 is ruled out so it is the only blocker
    PR #1998  bug-1286-work   the watch.rs rebase conflict
    BUG-1532  c1-5 and c7-9, as authorised

Take them in that order unless you have already started 1998. If you have, finish it —
switching costs more than the ordering gains.

ONE THING I DID WHILE YOU WERE ON #2034, so you are not surprised by a moved head: I
pushed a docs-only commit to PR #1984 (266e973a36) addressing all three reviewer findings
there — repointed two matrix cells at TASK-1308, fixed the completion clause, and made
the Evidence section state its own scope. One file, 17 insertions, no code. I authored it
so I cannot merge it; the reviewer can and will once its Build lands.
subject: #2034 confirmed green + verified-run; ball is with the reviewer. Your queue: PR-2039 test, then PR-1998 rebase, then BUG-1532
